key_insight: Selecting sparse CT views for hemodynamic prediction rather than image reconstruction improves TAWSS prediction, with Agentic and Soft top-K selection achieving the lowest mean field errors.
engineering_relevance: Task-aware acquisition could enable fewer CT projections while preserving information needed to predict aneurysm wall shear stress.
method: Generate synthetic fan-beam CTA projections from intracranial aneurysm CFD simulations.
Train a Fourier neural operator to predict spatial TAWSS fields and spatially averaged TAWSS.
Compare uniform and golden-angle sampling with Gumbel-Softmax, Soft top-K, and agentic AI selection across view budgets.
evidence_signal: On synthetic CTA data, Agentic selection slightly outperformed Soft top-K for spatial TAWSS, and both substantially outperformed fixed sampling under extreme sparsity.
watch_item: Validation on clinical acquisitions is needed; masks optimized for hemodynamic prediction produced poor image reconstructions.
paper_title: Agentic AI Reasoning and Learned Sampling for Task-Aware Projection Selection in Sparse-View CT: Predicting Hemodynamics
